## Type of change

- [ ] New skill

## Skill checklist (for new or changed skills)

- [ ] `SKILL.md` starts with `name` (lowercase, hyphens) and a `description` that says when to use it
- [ ] Added or updated the entry in `library.json` (category, job, level, needs, license, try_prompt)
- [ ] Ran `python3 tools/build_docs.py` so `LIBRARY.md` and `site/library.html` are up to date
- [ ] Tried the skill's example prompt in Claude or Copilot and the answer followed the skill
- [ ] License and credit are correct for skills from other authors
